rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 18, CREATING THE SUGAR REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: The unabated importation of cheap, dumped and subsidized sugar into the country two years ago has exacted great financial strain to the sugar industry. Continuation of this situation will inevitably wipe out the sugar industry. > This bill empowers the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) to declare as RESERVE any EXCESS importation of sugar.
rows.status: Approved on Third Reading on 2001-05-30

rows.abstract: Rationale: Autism as a developmental disability remains unknown in the country because of the lack of government support. rows.author: C128
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE CONVERSION OF ELECTRIC COOPERATIVES INTO STOCK COOPERATIVES, AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6938 (COOPERATIVE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES), REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6939 AND PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 269, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Converting electric cooperatives (ECs) into stock cooperatives has these advantages: (1) more active involvement of member-consumer s; (2) mobilization of members' savings and increase of the internal capital of ECs; (3) decrease in line losses; and(4) increased collection efficiency.

rows.abstract: Rationale: Electric cooperatives (ECs) play a vital role in rural electrification and rural development, thus the government must continuously strive to improve the transparency of the ECs. This is especially important given the repeated reports ofover-staying directors and officers of ECs and allegation of dubious transactions and practices of some ECs.
